_doc: Golden-set eval for the CIR engine. Labeled known cases used to measure screening precision/recall (esp. FALSE NEGATIVES — a missed true sanctions hit is a regulatory incident) plus adverse-media recall, identity resolution, and groundedness. Keep small + curated; expand as real cases are learned. `expect.sanctions`: hit|clear. `expect.adverse`: true|false. `expect.identity`: substring the registry evidence must contain (CIN/LEI), or null.
